name: Zhao Jinmai
bio:
Zhao Jinmai is an actor born in Shenyang, China. In 2012, she made her acting debut at just ten years old in the drama “Cannot No Mother” (不能没有娘). She made her film debut at the age of twelve in “Balala the Fairies: The Movie” (巴啦啦小魔仙大电影) in 2013.

In 2020, Zhao Jin Mai got a high score of 524 in National Higher Education Entrance Examination and ranked first in the Central Academy of Drama. She graduated from Central Academy of Drama in June 2024.
